title: fix(app-shell): PagePreview decides "record page" from `type` alone — `pageType` is an alias PageSchema refuses (objectui#10482)
body:
Fixes #10482
Clause-②: no

The page designer's `PagePreview` now decides "record page" from `type` alone, as the runtime resolver `usePageAssignment` does. The `pageType: 'record'` leg of `isRecordPage` is gone, and so is the ⚠️ comment block that described it; a two-line comment in its place says the preview reads `type` alone because `PageSchema` refuses the `pageType` alias. There is no `pageType` fallback anywhere (triage ruling 5828249870: 「read `type`, the one discriminator; ⛔ no consumer-side alias for a refused key.」).

Implemented by the `domain:ui` seat 5 dispatch (claim comment 5829587006), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`.

## Measured first

**The contract, on the installed pin** (`@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, `PageSchema` from `dist/ui`), parsed in this worktree:

```
BASE type:record                 success=true
BASE + pageType:record           success=false  unrecognized_keys ["pageType"]  "... Did you mean `pageType` → `type`? ..."
pageType:record only, no type    success=false  unrecognized_keys ["pageType"]
CONTROL nonsense key             success=false  unrecognized_keys ["zzzNotAKey"]
type:app                         success=true
```

**The site, at base `4a7ef0d`.** `isRecordPage` read `type === 'record'` OR `pageType === 'record'`. `git grep -n pageType -- packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` returns 10 lines in 3 files. The only reader is `isRecordPage` in `PagePreview.tsx`. The `nav-target.ts` hit is a comment saying `pageType` is not read, and the 4 `nav-target.test.ts` hits pin that. Nothing outside `PagePreview.tsx` is left for this card.

## The pin

`previews/__tests__/page-preview-record-type-10482.test.tsx` mounts the real `PagePreview` in preview mode. It stubs the global `fetch` and swaps `RecordContextProvider` for a spy that still renders its children, then reads three things from one settle window: which URLs were fetched, which object a record context was opened for, and whether the "Preview record" picker is on screen.

| case | base | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| fixtures judged by `PageSchema` (lit parses; alias refused by key, `unrecognized_keys` naming `pageType`) | pass | pass |
| lit control: `type: 'record'` + `object`: schema and records fetched, context opened, picker shown | pass | pass |
| `pageType: 'record'` + `object`, no `type`: no fetch, no context, no picker | **fail** (2 URLs fetched) | pass |
| `type: 'app'` + `pageType: 'record'`: unbound | **fail** (2 URLs fetched) | pass |
| second control: `type: 'app'` + `object`: unbound | pass | pass |

- Red on base, measured twice. First the pin commit `f800c38` on top of the unchanged base component: `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`, exit 1. Then the final pin at head `3e86cb9` with `PagePreview.tsx` swapped for its base blob `63d7deb` (disk hash checked equal to the base blob): `Tests 2 failed | 3 passed (5)`, exit 1.
- Restored with `git checkout HEAD --` on that path. Proof of the restore: the disk hash equals the HEAD blob `c077276` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The same run then read `Tests 5 passed (5)`, exit 0. The swap ran under an EXIT/INT/TERM trap.
- The subject is imported by relative path from `src`, so no `dist` rebuild stands between the swap and the reading.

## Gates (at head `3e86cb9` unless noted)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`: `Test Files 302 passed (302)`, `Tests 3428 passed | 1 skipped (3429)`, exit 0. Before the merge commit, at `1e97a27`: 300 files, 3422 passed, exit 0.
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter @object-ui/app-shell --concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 30 successful, 30 total`, exit 0. The echoed script is `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new pin once.
- eslint, plain form, on the 2 changed source files: 0 errors. `PagePreview.tsx` has 15 warnings (`no-explicit-any`, `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect`), and its base blob linted from stdin gives the same 15. The pin has 0 warnings.
  - Population: `packages/app-shell`'s `lint` script is `eslint .`, and both files appear in `--format json` output (2 file results, none ignored).
  - Invariance: `eslint.config.js` has no `parserOptions` / `projectService` / `project:` / type-checked config (0 hits; the control `languageOptions` gets 1 hit). No local rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem (0 hits). So this diff cannot change the verdict on any file it does not touch.
- Exit 0 at `3e86cb9`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (1 released package, 1 changeset declared).
- Re-derived against the actual diff, all exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-type-check-coverage`, `check-lint-coverage`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:spec-symbols`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the 3 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

## Changeset

`.changeset/10482-page-preview-reads-type.md` is a `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`. It says what the diff does and cites the card.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim's reproduction clause says that on the base a `type: 'record'` draft does not get a record preview. On base `4a7ef0d` it does: the `type` leg was already there, so that case is the lit control and passes on both sides. What was red on base is the alias cases.
- The dispatch pointed to `page-tabs-item-value-8278.test.tsx` as a mount harness. That file does not mount `PagePreview`. The harness the pin follows is `PagePreview.expandFls-7429.test.tsx` (it stubs `fetch` and mocks `@object-ui/react` with the real module spread in).
- `pageType` hits outside `metadata-admin` (`PageView.tsx`, `runtime-metadata-persistence.ts`, the `page` renderer) belong to the render-node layer, where `pageType` is the page-node member that `PageView` maps metadata `type` onto. This card does not touch them.
